```python
import importlib.util
import sys
import types
import inspect
import textwrap

import pytest

from docstring_parser import parser
from docstring_parser.common import DocstringStyle, Docstring


def test_parse_from_object_class_attribute_docstrings(tmp_path):
    # Create a temporary module file with a class that has attribute docstrings
    module_code = textwrap.dedent(
        """
        class MyClass:
            \"\"\"Example class.\n\n            Attributes:\n                attr1: The first attribute.\n                attr2: The second attribute.\n        \"\"\"

            attr1 = 1
            attr2 = 2
        """
    )
    module_file = tmp_path / "mymodule.py"
    module_file.write_text(module_code)

    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("mymodule", module_file)
    mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    sys.modules["mymodule"] = mod
    spec.loader.exec_module(mod)

    # Parse the class
    doc = parser.parse_from_object(mod.MyClass, style=DocstringStyle.GOOGLE)

    # The class docstring should be parsed
    assert isinstance(doc, Docstring)
    assert doc.short_description == "Example class."

    # Attribute docstrings should be added
    attrs = {a.name: a for a in doc.attributes}
    assert "attr1" in attrs
    assert "attr2" in attrs
    assert attrs["attr1"].description == "The first attribute."
    assert attrs["attr2"].description == "The second attribute."


def test_parse_from_object_module_attribute_docstrings(tmp_path):
    # Create a temporary module with module-level attribute docstrings
    module_code = textwrap.dedent(
        """
        \"\"\"Module docstring.\n\n        Attributes:\n            module_attr: A module attribute.\n        \"\"\"

        module_attr = "value"
        """
    )
    module_file = tmp_path / "modattr.py"
    module_file.write_text(module_code)

    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("modattr", module_file)
    mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    sys.modules["modattr"] = mod
    spec.loader.exec_module(mod)

    # Parse the module
    doc = parser.parse_from_object(mod, style=DocstringStyle.GOOGLE)

    # Module docstring should be parsed
    assert doc.short_description == "Module docstring."

    # Attribute docstrings should be added
    attrs = {a.name: a for a in doc.attributes}
    assert "module_attr" in attrs
    assert attrs["module_attr"].description == "A module attribute."


def test_parse_from_object_no_docstring_and_no_attributes():
    # Define a simple function with no docstring
    def func_no_doc():
        pass

    # Parse the function
    doc = parser.parse_from_object(func_no_doc, style=DocstringStyle.GOOGLE)

    # The parsed Docstring should have empty fields
    assert isinstance(doc, Docstring)
    assert doc.short_description == ""
    assert doc.long_description == ""
    assert doc.params == []
    assert doc.returns is None
    assert doc.raises == []
    assert doc.attributes == []
```
